data.name: Challenge
data.description: %1/day [Swift Action], you can challenge a foe to combat. Choose one target within sight to challenge. Your melee attacks deal %2 extra damage whenever the attacks are made against the target of the challenge. Challenging a foe requires much of the cavalier's concentration. The cavalier takes a -2 penalty to his Armor Class, except against attacks made by the target of his challenge. The challenge remains in effect until the target is dead or unconscious or until the combat ends. Each cavalier's challenge also includes another effect which is listed in the section describing the cavalier's order.|CavalierChallengeTimes|CavalierChallengeLVL

raw_tokens.value: %1/day [Swift Action], you can challenge a foe to combat. Choose one target within sight to challenge. Your melee attacks deal %2 extra damage whenever the attacks are made against the target of the challenge. Challenging a foe requires much of the cavalier's concentration. The cavalier takes a -2 penalty to his Armor Class, except against attacks made by the target of his challenge. The challenge remains in effect until the target is dead or unconscious or until the combat ends. Each cavalier's challenge also includes another effect which is listed in the section describing the cavalier's order.|CavalierChallengeTimes|CavalierChallengeLVL

He receives a +%1 morale bonus on all melee damage rolls made against the target of his challenge as long as he is the only creature threatening the target. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels the cavalier possesses.|1+OrderChallengeBonus|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Order of the Cockatrice

His allies receive a +%1 circumstance bonus on melee attack rolls against the target of his challenge whenever he is threatening the target.|1+OrderChallengeBonus|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Order of the Dragon

He receives a +%1 dodge bonus to his AC against attacks made by the target of his challenge. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels the cavalier possesses.|1+OrderChallengeBonus|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Order of the Lion

He receives a +%1 morale bonus on attack rolls made against the target of his challenge if the target makes an attack against a target other than the cavalier. This bonus lasts for 1 minute. The bonus increases by +1 for every four levels the cavalier possesses.|1+OrderChallengeBonus|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Order of the Shield

He receives a +%1 morale bonus on all his saving throws as long as he is threatening the target of his challenge. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels the cavalier possesses.|1+OrderChallengeBonus|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Order of the Star

He receives a +%1 morale bonus on attack rolls against the target of his challenge so long as he is astride his mount. The bonus increases by +1 for every four levels the cavalier possesses.|1+OrderChallengeBonus|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Order of the Sword
